title: DLAM: Distributional Latent Actions with Temporal Constraints
summary: DLAM: Distributional Latent Actions with Temporal Constraints｜Vision-language-action (VLA) models remain constrained by scarce action-labeled robot data, whereas action-free videos

extra.description: Vision-language-action (VLA) models remain constrained by scarce action-labeled robot data, whereas action-free videos offer abundant observations of physical change. Latent action models can extract such priors, but reconstruction-trained codes may predict future observations without the structure required for joint generation with robot actions.
